verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a web search feature that finds relevant websites from a single query, and a separate fetch feature that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. Nothing shows search results returning full page content in one call. Chaining the two endpoints is a developer workaround, not the single-call capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
